In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] ran a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas '''mining facility''' on the planet [[Kril'Dor/Legends|Kril'Dor]]. It was [[Mission to Kril'Dor|captured]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] thanks to the efforts of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]].
